name: IN/OUT: Breathing Timer
subtitle: Breathe for what's next
shortDescription: Guided breathing, custom patterns and private before-and-after check-ins.
description:
Choose a structured breathing practice, follow native visual, audio and haptic guidance, and optionally record how you feel before and afterward. Core practice works offline without an account. All nine normal launch protocols are included in Free.

The planned commercial v1 adds monthly and annual Pro, conservative ads for Free users, deeper progress features and shareable browser resets. Provider integrations and final subscription pricing/trial terms are still under development. This draft is not approved store copy.

State Shift is self-reported, not biometric. Breathe comfortably and stop if dizzy, faint or unwell. IN/OUT is not a medical device. High-intensity cyclic breathing is excluded.
